map.由斜距与垂直角求水平距 使用指南: Horizontal Distance from Slope Distance and Vertical Angle User Guide
map.输入斜距 S 与垂直角 v（度），按 H=S·cos(v) 计算对应的水平距离，: Enter the slope distance S and the vertical angle v (degrees) and compute the corresponding horizontal distance as H = S*cos(v); used in trigonometric leveling and topographic surveying to convert a slope distance into a horizontal distance.
map.平距 = 斜距·cos(垂直角): Horizontal distance = slope distance * cos(vertical angle)
map.输入斜距 S 与垂直角 v（度），求水平距离。: Enter the slope distance S and the vertical angle v (degrees) to get the horizontal distance.
map.由斜距与倾角算水平距。: Compute the horizontal distance from the slope distance and the inclination angle.
map.全站仪斜距改化。: Slope distance reduction for a total station.
map.坡地边长归算。: Reduction of side lengths on sloping ground.
map.：斜距 100.5m、俯角 5.71%（≈天顶距 84.29°）→ 水平距=10: : Slope distance 100.5 m with a depression angle of 5.71% (a zenith distance of about 84.29 degrees) -> horizontal distance = 100.5 x sin(84.29 degrees) = 100.0 m.
map.：10% 坡下斜距比水平距长约 0.5%，大坡（30%）差达 15%，必须改化。: : On a 10% slope the slope distance is about 0.5% longer than the horizontal distance, and on a steep slope (30%) the difference reaches 15%, so reduction is mandatory.
